children: India's wholesale inflation (INWPI=ECI) accelerated to 11.39% year-on-year in September, government data showed on Wednesday, as oil and food prices increased at a faster pace.
The print was higher than the 9.92% rise a month ago and economists' average projection of 10.18% in a Reuters poll.
- Wholesale food prices rose 8.66% year-on-year in September after rising 7.05% in August
- Prices of manufactured products rose 9.76% year-on-year in September after an 8.37% year-on-year rise a month ago
- Fuel and power prices increased 25.85% year-on-year in September, as against a rise of 22.93% a month ago
- Petroleum and natural gas prices rose 57.32% year-on-year in September after a 34.41% rise in August
